question.text: Ms. Priya Shah is drafting the 'audit trail' section of the SIR per Chapter 7.3.2. Which of the following MUST the audit trail document?

answer.text: Which stakeholders, outcomes or indicators were INCLUDED and which were EXCLUDED, with a rationale for each decision
Only the indicators that were included, since omitted indicators are irrelevant
Only the identity of external reviewers
Only the total fees paid to the SIA

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.3.2 requires 'an audit trail for decision-making, including which stakeholders, outcomes or indicators were included and which were not, and a rationale for each of these decisions.' Both inclusions and exclusions must be documented. The Trap: A omits the 'which were not' leg — exclusions are where selection bias hides. C and D confuse professional-fee disclosure with the decision trail. Cross-Exam Context: Mirrors the 'exceptions and exclusions' log expected in statutory audits (ICAI SA 230 documentation standards). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Maintain the audit trail as a single spreadsheet: Indicator | SAS code | Included? Y/N | Rationale | Reviewer initials | Date. Export to PDF and attach to the SIR as Annexure A — it is the #1 document SEBI inspectors request post-filing.
